stem:
Kevin has a maximum of $28 to spend at a movie theater. He will spend $15 on a movie ticket, and he can spend the rest of the money on popcorn and a drink.

Complete the inequality to represent all possible values of y, the amount in dollars that Kevin can spend on popcorn and a drink.

Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
